subject: Draft MAP: milestones, owners, and proposed close windows
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Claire James <claire@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP: milestones, owners, and proposed close windows

Hi Claire — thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. As promised I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) to capture milestones, proposed owners, dependencies, and two close-window options so we can align on a realistic timeline. Please review and confirm the stakeholders listed below (or add any missing names) and pick which close-window you prefer.

Highlights (from the call):
- Primary goals: pilot Redwood Inference for clinical note summarization and secure embeddings for search.
- Success metrics: 95% uptime during pilot, sub-200ms p95 inference for single-seat flows, and integration with Helix SSO.

MAP summary (attached: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx):
1) Milestone: Pilot kick-off (kickoff + environment access) — Proposed owner: Claire James (Helix) / Redwood: Monica Patel — Target: Week A or Week B (options below)
2) Milestone: Model selection & quantization profile — Redwood: Marcus Lin — Dependency: sample dataset + performance targets
3) Milestone: Integration & SSO + testing — Helix: Tom Li / Redwood: Karthik Iyer — Dependency: SAML metadata, test accounts
4) Milestone: Pilot validation & review — Joint owners — Sign-off criteria: accuracy thresholds + perf SLA

Proposed close windows (pick one):
- Option 1: Target close by 2026-12-20 (aggressive; requires procurement + security responses within 7 business days)
- Option 2: Target close by 2027-01-15 (safer; allows procurement review + a short legal redline cycle)

Open dependencies / risks (please flag additional ones):
- Procurement needs SOC 2 attestation and retention policy doc (we attached a sample evidence pack).
- Network allowlist and VPC peering timing may add 1-2 weeks depending on Helix infra resources.

Next steps / asks:
- Claire: confirm the Helix stakeholder roster to be copied into the MAP (names + emails).
- Procurement: confirm preferred payment terms (Net-30 / Net-45) and required contractual clauses.
- Redwood: we will iterate the MAP and circulate a v1.1 with your inputs by EOD Thursday (11/26).

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx, Discovery-Notes-Helix-20261124.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to alignment.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
From: Claire James <claire@helixhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@helixhealth.com>, Helix Health Procurement <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: milestones, owners, and proposed close windows

Thanks Mina — this looks like a great starting point. A few quick notes:

1) Stakeholders: please add Sarah Nguyen (Clinical Ops, sarah.nguyen@helixhealth.com) and Daniel Park (IT security, daniel.park@helixhealth.com). Tom will be our engineering lead for integration.
2) Close window: we prefer Option 2 (target close by 2027-01-15) to give Procurement time to review.
3) Procurement note: we typically run a 10-business-day review for vendor security and financial terms. I copied Procurement on this thread — Tom, can you confirm availability for a short technical Q&A next week?

Also, procurement will want the SOC 2 report and a brief diagram of where data will be stored and for how long — happy to receive whatever you can share.

Claire
Claire James
VP, Product & Clinical Innovation
Helix Health
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Claire James <claire@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@helixhealth.com>, Helix Health Procurement <procurement@helixhealth.com>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@helixhealth.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@helixhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 14:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: milestones, owners, and proposed close windows

Thanks Claire — I've updated the MAP with Sarah and Daniel and moved the target close to 2027-01-15 per your preference. New file attached (MAP-draft-v1-1.xlsx).

Quick notes on procurement & security artifacts:
- Attached we included a high-level evidence pack (Discovery-Notes-Helix-20261124.pdf) and a link to our SOC 2 summary. Full SOC 2 report is available under an NDA; happy to coordinate with Procurement for that handoff.
- Data retention: pilot logs and embeddings retention default to 30 days; we can configure longer retention on request — flag if you need a specific policy.

Tom — on the technical Q&A: Karthik and Marcus are available for a 60-minute deep-dive Wednesday 12/2 between 10–12 PT. If that works for you I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda:
  - 15m architecture + infra needs
  - 25m integration details (SSO, network, test data)
  - 20m perf targets and quantization tradeoffs

Next steps I will take by EOD Thursday: finalize MAP v1.1 in HubSpot, add HubSpot deal link, and share a short onboarding checklist.

Best,
Mina

Claire + team — thanks for confirming the roster and timeline. I can take point on the technical onboarding session and will prepare a short runbook for the first two weeks of the pilot (access instructions, sample test scripts, perf checklist).

Tom — if Wednesday 12/2 10–11 PT works, I’ll send an invite for that slot and include a Teams link and runbook draft. If you prefer a deeper hands-on workshop, we can expand to 90 minutes with a small lab environment provisioned in advance.

Mina — I’ll also add an internal task to track the SOC 2 NDA handoff and the network allowlist items so nothing slips.
